description.en: The experience at this place is something else. Try before you buy!! If you haven't been to Johnny Vapes before, you owe it to yourself to check them out. Their customer service is on a whole other level!

Great Selection and Service!
I recently visited this vape shop and was thoroughly impressed with their selection and customer service. The staff was knowledgeable and helped me find exactly what I needed. Prices were competitive, and the quality of their products was top-notch. I also appreciate their variety of brands and providing detailed information about their products. Definitely a go-to spot for all vaping needs!

Walked in and was greeted immediately. Was offered to try the disposable vapes available which I took advantage of trying some of those odd name flavors I've wanted to try without dropping 25$ for something that sounds better than it tastes. Employee sanitized all vapes I sampled before putting them back. Very professional, friendly, and knowledgeable staff. Will return.

Johnny vapes has been my best experience at a vape shop. Massive selection, anything you could ask for. Luke was extremely friendly and I never felt pressured. You can test everything in the store, so you don’t end up getting something you don’t like. I won’t go anywhere else now.
